new_profile_content:
capabilities:
  catalog: .vera-mmu/capabilities.yaml
entities:
  types:
  - COMPONENT
  - MODULE
  - SYMBOL
  - TEST
  - BUILD
  - DEPLOY
front:
  fields:
  - active_goal
  - current_work
  - validated_facts
  - blockers
  - risks
  - next_action
gates:
  catalog: .vera-mmu/gates.yaml
identity:
  include_profile_hash: true
  include_vcs_revision: true
integrations:
  agent_profiles: .vera-mmu/agent-profiles.yaml
  enabled:
  - claude-code-local
knowledge:
  types:
  - RULE
  - DECISION
  - OBSERVATION
  - HYPOTHESIS
  - STATE
  - MEASUREMENT
  - DISCOVERY
  - ARCHITECTURE
mmu:
  version: '2.0'
policies:
  file: .vera-mmu/policies.yaml
project:
  description: Profil VERA initialisé pour Automatic Reverse Engineering Toolkit
  domain: software
  id: aret-toolkit
  name: Automatic Reverse Engineering Toolkit
relations:
  types:
  - VERIFIED_BY
  - SUPERSEDES
  - INFORMED_BY
  - BLOCKED_BY
  - IMPLEMENTS
  - DERIVED_FROM
  - CONCERNS
  - APPLIES_TO
  - CAUSED_BY
  - EVOLVES_TO
resume:
  template: engineering
  sections:
  - id: working-rules
    required: true
  - id: current-state
    required: true
  - id: validated-facts
    required: true
  - id: risks
    required: true
  - id: next-action
    required: true
storage:
  artifacts_dir: artifacts
  max_context_bytes: 18500
  max_resume_bytes: 14000
  memory_dir: .vera-mmu
  sqlite_file: memory.sqlite
work:
  enabled: true
workspace:
  additional_roots: []
  root: .
